title: Jonah and the Big Fish
reflectionQuestion: Where do you think God was, the whole time Jonah was inside the big fish?
kidSafetyNotes: Danger-as-awe, not terror: storm resolves into stillness; being put into the sea is calm and gentle; inside the fish is dark but 'safe, warm, not alone'. Scripture: fish sets Jonah on DRY LAND, he then travels to Nineveh (avoids the kid_113 'dropped at Nineveh' error); no invented crown. Jonah 4 epilogue (anger/plant/worm) intentionally omitted as tonally wrong for 4-7; faithful to outcome + emotional truth. One indelible image: Jonah opening his eyes inside the fish.
